name: oja-talu
description: Build tooling for the Oja Talu WordPress block theme's custom Gutenberg blocks.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build blocks/src/hero blocks/src/story blocks/src/brand-card blocks/src/brand-cards blocks/src/season blocks/src/journal-entry blocks/src/product-feature blocks/src/visit --output-path=blocks/build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start blocks/src/hero blocks/src/story blocks/src/brand-card blocks/src/brand-cards blocks/src/season blocks/src/journal-entry blocks/src/product-feature blocks/src/visit --output-path=blocks/build
